description: Hand-authored synthetic records of a fictional school district (Merrow Vale Unified), two fictional schools and one fictional family, for reproducible acceptance; not a benchmark task. Workflow shapes were informed by public product pages of ParentSquare (https://www.parentsquare.com/) and the PowerSchool parent portal (https://www.powerschool.com/); no data, text, branding or icons were taken from them.

sources.description: Hand-authored synthetic records; no external collection. Phone numbers use the fictional 555-01xx range.

transformations: Timestamps carry explicit UTC offsets; school days and cut-offs are resolved in America/Los_Angeles.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism (policy values, school calendar, notification wording) and of the fictional status of the district and people.
